1月27号，除夕。距离抵达桂省已经一个月，少数连队分批次往前拱到了边境一线，九连就在其中。
幽静的山谷之中，几盏昏黄灯光闪烁，完全没有过年的气氛。远处的村庄里，时不时能够听到响起的鞭炮声，显得这里愈发宁静。
九连被派驻到了宁明一线的深山里，上级配发的只有少量猪肉和白面。旁边有个村庄，但是没人敢去和当地的老乡联欢。食堂里，连队包了饺子就算过年了。
经过一个多月的训练，刘济民整个人都瘦了一圈，看起来更精壮了。
桂省日照强，连队众人都黑了不少，大家都调侃这下打起夜仗来更有优势了。
驻地周围派出了外围警戒哨，而且都加了双岗还有暗哨，这里距离边境还很远，但也怕敌人过来摸哨卡。
驻地内，热乎乎的饺子被成盆成盆地端了上来，牛肉罐头，压缩饼干算是点心。刘济民托后勤的人搞到了几斤糖，平均下来每人能分到一颗。
“以白茶代酒，咱们喝一个！”刘济民笑着举起冒烟的茶缸，众人立即起哄举起了杯子。
“喝！”
马贵生笑着说道：“大家赶紧吃，吃完之后还有一轮饺子，今天吃饱。根据上级通知，明天上午大年初一，咱们休息半天！”
“好！”
一声令下，大家疯狂往餐盒里扒拉饺子，紧接着低头狼吞虎咽地吃了起来。每天上午负重训练五小时，下午练习枪法、爆破，晚上再练急行军，现在每人的胃口都大得惊人。
第一轮大家都吃得差不多了，几个班分别出了几个节目，大多都是豫省的传统戏剧、曲剧之类。
会餐结束，刘济民和连长马贵生带着两人巡查哨位，确保没事后才回去休息。
............
燕京，刚下过一场大雪，雪白的地面映照着红色的灯光。除夕夜里，大杂院里张灯结彩，刘家的门口也挂上了红灯笼。
家家户户的灶上都炖着肉，香味在胡同上方汇聚。穿着棉袄的小孩子在大街上跑来跑去，鞭炮声此起彼伏。
火药味和肉香味夹杂在一起，再伴随着欢声笑语，这就是中国人的年味。
院子里家家户户互相说完吉祥话后，就跑回各家屋里头关起门来享受起美食。

January 27th, New Year’s Eve. It has been a month since they arrived in Guangxi Province. A few companies have moved forward in batches to the border line, and the Ninth Company is among them.
In the quiet valley, a few dim lights flickered, and there was no New Year atmosphere at all. In the distant village, the sound of firecrackers can be heard from time to time, making the place seem more and more peaceful.
The Ninth Company was stationed in the mountains near Ningming, and the superiors only distributed a small amount of pork and white flour. There is a village nearby, but no one dares to socialize with the local folks. In the cafeteria, the company made dumplings to celebrate the New Year.
After more than a month of training, Liu Jimin lost weight and looked stronger.
The sunshine in Guangxi Province was strong, and everyone in the company was a lot darker. Everyone joked that it would be more advantageous to fight at night.
Peripheral guard posts have been dispatched around the station, and double posts and hidden posts have been added. This place is still far from the border, but we are afraid that the enemy will come and touch the guard posts.
Inside the station, hot dumplings were served in basins, canned beef, and compressed biscuits as snacks. Liu Jimin asked the logistics people to get several kilograms of candy, and on average each person could get one.
"Let's drink white tea instead of wine!" Liu Jimin smiled and raised the smoking teapot, and everyone immediately cheered and raised their cups.
"Drink!"
Ma Guisheng said with a smile: "Everyone eat quickly. After eating, there will be a round of dumplings. We are full today. According to the notice from our superiors, we will have a half-day break tomorrow morning on the first day of the Lunar New Year!"
"Okay!"
After giving the order, everyone frantically shoveled the dumplings into the lunch boxes, then lowered their heads and ate them hungrily. After five hours of weight-bearing training every morning, marksmanship and blasting practice in the afternoon, and emergency marching in the evening, everyone now has an astonishing appetite.
In the first round, everyone had almost eaten. Several classes presented several programs, most of which were traditional dramas and operas from Henan Province.
After the dinner, Liu Jimin and company commander Ma Guisheng led them to inspect the outpost and make sure everything was okay before going back to rest.
............
In Yanjing, there has just been a heavy snowfall, and the white ground reflects the red lights. On New Year's Eve, the courtyard was decorated with lanterns and red lanterns were hung at the door of Liu's house.
Every household has meat stewed on the stove, and the aroma gathers above the alley. Children wearing cotton-padded jackets ran up and down the street, and firecrackers sounded one after another.
The smell of gunpowder and meat are mixed together, accompanied by laughter and laughter. This is the Chinese New Year flavor.
After every household in the yard finished saying auspicious words to each other, they ran back to their houses and closed the doors to enjoy the delicious food.
